title: Email Content: Flock, ShotSpotter, and Axon Threads, 2022 to 2026 (Mayor)

communications.subject: Georgia Open Records Act Request: Email Content: Flock, ShotSpotter, and Axon Threads, 2022 to 2026 (Mayor)
communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Georgia Open Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

This request follows ORR-2706-2026, in which the City produced email metadata for the Mayor’s Office. Please produce the complete content, including the message text, all replies and forwards, and all attachments, of the following email threads, from every City account that sent or received them. In priority order:

“Invitation: Flock Safety Meet & Greet (Ruth Chris Steakhouse) @ Fri Jun 5, 2026,” June 4, 2026, including the invitation’s location and attendee list.
“Thanks for the note on FB - promised follow up,” January 13, 2026.
“ShotSpotter Request” (including “FW: ShotSpotter Request” and “RE: ShotSpotter Request”), October 21 to December 22, 2022.
“TASER Risk Management Training Follow-Up,” May 30 to July 10, 2025.
“Fwd: Jan 18 Axon Enterprise Mayors Roundtable Luncheon,” January 5 and 9, 2023.

If item 5 is large because of attachments, please send items 1 to 4 first and give me the estimate for item 5. To keep the estimate accurate, please remove exact duplicates before review and release, and do not review any pages that contain nothing that could be exempt, such as meeting invitations and automated notices. Please give me the page count for each numbered item. I am glad to narrow the request if an estimate exceeds $25.

If any responsive record is withheld in whole or in part, please identify the specific legal authority by Code section, subsection, and paragraph, as O.C.G.A. § 50-18-71(d) provides, and produce all reasonably segregable portions. If there are no records for an item, please say so for that item. I do not authorize any work that would exceed $25 until I have approved the estimate.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 3 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Ethan Watters

title: Use of Accurint in Fulton County, GA voter review surge

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

We are requesting the following records about the FBI analyst "surge support" sent to Atlanta in July 2026:

1. The memo or electronic communication sent to FBI field offices on or about July 1, 2026 asking each office to assign analysts to support a priority investigation in Atlanta, as reported by CBS News on July 2, 2026 (https://www.cbsnews.com/news/fbi-orders-field-offices-analysts-atlanta-election-investigation/).

2. The written instructions, task guidance, or training materials, including videos or video transcripts, given to FBI personnel assigned to that surge that explain how to perform the records checks, including any instruction to check records against Accurint or another commercial database and any guidance on how to record discrepancies. Voices may be changed and faces blurred to hide the identity of personnel in training videos. 

3. Any privacy review of using commercial data for those checks (reports list Accurint as the software used) completed between January 1, 2026 and August 31, 2026, such as a Privacy Threshold Analysis, Privacy Impact Assessment, or a written approval from the FBI Privacy and Civil Liberties Unit or Office of the General Counsel.

4. Records showing the total overtime hours or overtime cost charged to the surge, as a total or by field office.

5. Records showing any batch or bulk job (a file of many names or records submitted to LexisNexis for processing in one job, such as through Accurint Batch) submitted from an FBI account between June 1, 2026 and August 31, 2026, limited to the date of each job, the job and file name, the number of records in it, and the FBI office or division that submitted it. I am not requesting the contents of any file.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Shawn Segal
